title: Beyond Static Computation: Object-Centric Structural Evolution and Persistent Intelligence
description: A specification-first research synthesis connecting five complementary research programs—Adversarial Structural Security Intelligence (ASSI), Dynamic Bucket Tree of Permutation (D-BTP), Constrained Delta Evolution (CDE), World Entity and Structural Intelligence Operations (WE-SIO), and Object-Centric Structural Reasoning and Evolution (OCSRE). The repository examines object-native representations, residual-first in-situ intelligence, constrained structural evolution, persistent structural discovery, and evidence-bound capability relay. It provides research papers, interface and validation specifications, falsifiable hypotheses, and proposed experiments in SQL/CDC discovery, dynamic scheduling, and financial time-series analysis. The proposed mechanisms are research hypotheses and designs, not claims of demonstrated superiority or completed experimental validation.
notes: Initial research synthesis and experimental designs. No DOI, repository URL, or completed validation is asserted in this metadata.
